operators.name: sigmoid_forward
semantics: Elementwise application of sigmoid: output[i] = 1 / (1 + exp(-input[i]))
Preserves shape, dtype, device and contiguous layout

operators.name: softmax_dim1_forward
semantics: Softmax over dim=1 (channels) for each batch and spatial position
For each (b, c, h, w): output[b,c,h,w] = exp(input[b,c,h,w]) / sum_{c'} exp(input[b,c',h,w])
Stable max subtraction is recommended for numerical accuracy
Preserves shape, dtype, device and contiguous layout
Elementwise sigmoid applied to all input elements
Same shape and dtype as input; output on CUDA
Softmax along dimension 1 (channels) independently for each batch and spatial location
Uses stable exponentiation with subtraction of max along dim=1 (keepdim=False)
Same shape and dtype as input; output on CUDA
Returns the softmax result, shape [512, 10, 200, 200], float32 CUDA tensor
